findings.text: the newly registered supersede-review verb appears in no line of skills/reckon-build/SKILL.md and is absent from CREW_VERBS_OUTSIDE_ORCHESTRATION in tests/test_skill_contracts.py, so tests/test_skill_contracts.py::test_every_registered_crew_verb_is_documented_or_exempt -- named in the plan's done-when -- now lists three undocumented verbs (check-review, repair-review, supersede-review) where the base listed two; the plan directs that this out-of-scope registration be added with crew widen naming skills/reckon-build/SKILL.md, which was not done, so the node's own verb does not satisfy the named check.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against the base; three commits (b7c35ae8d, 63171c42e, f417d0be1) add review_block in reckon/ledger.py, round_node_head_suffix in reckon/crew/repair.py, the supersede-review verb in reckon/crew_run_commands.py, route four readers through review_block, and add the test file and landing fragment.

item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records 12 passed for the two named test files, an after_suite of 0 failures and a negative-control base arm failing 7 cases by id, but attributes the test_skill_contracts failure solely to pre-existing verbs when this node's own verb is a third cause.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest and the diff; every changed path (reckon/ledger.py, reckon/crew/repair.py, reckon/capabilities.py, reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py, reckon/crew/picker/outcomes.py, reckon/crew_run_commands.py, tests/test_crew_help_names_its_state.py, tests/test_a_corrected_review_row_reads_as_unreviewed.py, docs/evidence/fragments/a-review-promotes-only-its-own-verdict/supersede-a-misattributed-review-row.html) is inside the declared scope; reckon/cli.py was declared and left unchanged.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_corrected_review_row_reads_as_unreviewed.py would redden if review_block returned the block again (accessor is None, medians empty) and shows 7 failing ids at base 49b9973b4, so it fails if the change regresses.
justifications.evidence: the essential-gate.log records 12 passed for tests/test_a_corrected_review_row_reads_as_unreviewed.py and tests/test_crew_help_names_its_state.py, and the base arm fails the 7 new cases by id, but the done_when's named tests/test_skill_contracts.py every-registered-verb check was run by no gate and is violated at the head (see FINDING).
justifications.fit: reckon/crew_run_commands.py:825 and reckon/ledger.py:3675 follow the surrounding docstring-and-structure idiom with no plan, ticket or version identifier, but the new verb is not carried into the skills/reckon-build contract its siblings honour.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew_run_commands.py:825 supersede_run_review appends review_correction {time, reason, dispatched_head, recorded_head, superseded_field} without rewriting recorded fields, and reckon/ledger.py:3675 review_block returns None for a corrected row so it drops out of totals and medians as the goal states.
justifications.reuse: review_block is defined on the row owner (reckon/ledger.py) and the four readers call it; round_node_head_suffix sits beside round_node_source in reckon/crew/repair.py and the verb reuses _review_record_subject, carried_revision_pair, same_revision and _commit_landing_writes rather than re-implementing them.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in git diff 49b9973b4..f417d0be lies inside the SCOPE fence in prompt.txt:69-80, but the plan's requirement to crew widen for the SKILL.md registration line was not taken, leaving the node's own registration outside the contract test's coverage.
